item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.responses`, captures kwargs in `fake_responses`, and invokes `dspy.LM(..., model_type='responses')`, so it inspects the post-conversion outbound request."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"`fake_responses` returns `FakeResponsesResp`, a response-like object with the fields needed for the call to complete without a real request."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `AnswerModel` as a `pydantic.BaseModel` subclass and passes it via `lm.forward(..., response_format=AnswerModel)` while using `model_type='responses'`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `\"response_format\" not in call`, directly checking the captured payload omits a top-level `response_format` field."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the schema is under `call[\"text\"][\"format\"]` with `name == \"AnswerModel\"`, `type == \"json_schema\"`, and expected schema properties from the Pydantic model."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
